summary: Perpetua Resources filed an 8-K announcing EXIM Bank approval of a $2.9 billion senior secured loan for its Stibnite Gold Project. The loan is a 13-year facility with $2.4 billion upfront plus capitalized interest, fixed at the long-dated U.S. Treasury rate plus 100 bps, repayments expected from 2030. Conditions precedent include definitive documentation and customary closing conditions; closure expected H2 2026. This is a financing milestone, not a change-of-control or capital-markets event. There is no deal or transaction reclassifiable under any special-situation category.
